skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Toolkit for applying curated color and font themes to slides, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages.
skill.summary: Apply curated palettes and font pairings to creative and business artifacts.
skill.author: 7Spade

security_audit.summary: The four external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around file and directory names in SKILL.md. The bundled PDF appears to be an expected ReportLab theme showcase; no active-content markers were found. No evidence of prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the reviewed skill instructions.

remediation.issue: Binary PDF assets are harder to audit than text theme sources.
remediation.suggestion: Include the source used to generate the PDF showcase or document how it was produced.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks enclose theme-showcase.pdf as Markdown inline code in a viewing instruction. There is no command string, interpreter call, or user-controlled shell execution.
The backticks mark theme-showcase.pdf as a referenced file in prose. This is Markdown formatting, not Ruby or shell command execution.
The backticks wrap the themes/ directory name in documentation. The instruction describes where theme files live and does not invoke an external command.
The line instructs the assistant to read a theme file from themes/ using Markdown code formatting for the path. It does not contain shell syntax or an executable command.

Manual file and string inspection shows a PDF 1.4 ReportLab showcase with no OpenAction, JavaScript, Launch, embedded file, form, or rich media markers. Confidence is not absolute because dedicated PDF parsing tools were unavailable.

content.user_title: Apply Polished Themes to Creative Artifacts
content.value_statement: Visual artifacts often lose consistency when colors and fonts are chosen manually. Theme Factory provides curated palettes and type pairings for slides, documents, reports, and HTML pages.
actual_capabilities: Shows a bundled PDF showcase of ten available themes before selection.
Provides ten named theme specifications with color palettes and header and body fonts.
Applies selected colors and fonts consistently to slides, documents, reports, or HTML artifacts.
Guides the user to confirm a chosen theme before modifying an artifact.
Can generate a custom theme when preset themes do not fit the artifact.
limitations: Does not include automation scripts for editing files; the AI must apply changes in the target artifact.
Theme quality depends on the source artifact structure and available styling controls.
The PDF showcase is a binary asset and cannot be edited by the skill instructions.
It does not guarantee accessibility compliance without a separate contrast and readability review.

use_cases.title: Standardize a Client Deck
use_cases.description: Apply one polished visual system across slides while preserving the existing message and structure.

use_cases.title: Refresh Internal Reports
use_cases.description: Use a consistent palette and typography system to make recurring reports easier to scan.

use_cases.title: Create a Branded Landing Page
use_cases.description: Select or create a theme that gives an HTML page a coherent visual identity.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the theme showcase and help me choose a theme for my slide deck.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review available presets before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Selected Preset
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this presentation. Keep the existing content and improve readability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: style an artifact with a named preset.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Theme Across Formats
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Botanical Garden for my report and matching HTML summary page. Keep headings, charts, and callouts visually consistent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: maintain one theme across multiple artifact types.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for an investor update about sustainable logistics. Present the palette and font choices for approval before applying them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: generate a new theme when presets do not fit.

output_examples.input: A consulting slide deck needs a more polished visual system.
output: The skill displays the showcase, asks for a theme selection, then applies chosen colors and fonts consistently.

output_examples.input: A report needs a new look but must keep its content unchanged.
output_examples.output: The output is a styled report using the selected theme, with improved headings, accents, and readable body text.

output_examples.input: None of the ten presets fit a nonprofit campaign.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes a custom theme name, palette, and font pairings, then waits for approval before applying it.

best_practices: Review the showcase first so stakeholders choose a theme before changes begin.
Keep source content stable while applying colors, fonts, and visual emphasis.
Run a contrast and readability check after applying or creating a theme.
anti_patterns: Applying a theme before the user confirms the selected preset.
Mixing multiple preset palettes in one artifact without a clear design reason.
Treating the showcase PDF as an editable source file.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes, each with colors, fonts, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create new themes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose a custom theme with a name, color palette, and font pairing for review.

faq.question: What file types can it style?
faq.answer: It can guide styling for slides, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages when those artifacts can be edited.

faq.question: Does it change content?
faq.answer: It is intended to change visual styling, not rewrite content unless the user asks.

faq.question: Does it include design assets?
faq.answer: It includes a showcase PDF and markdown theme specifications. It does not include image libraries.

faq.question: Is accessibility guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends contrast and readability checks, but separate accessibility review may be needed.
